Watts made this hymn from Psalm 49, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all inhabitants of the world, 2both low and high, rich and poor alike. 3My mouth will impart wisdom, and the meditation of my heart will bring understanding. 4I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle with the harp: … 16 more verses PSALM 49 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 49
They can't redeem one hour from death, With all the wealth in which they trust; Nor give a dying brother breath, When God commands him down to dust. STANZA II
Watts's psalms run from Psalm 1 to Psalm 150, several settings to many psalms: 367 hymns. This is number 3. Point at a tick to see the hymn; click it to open that hymn.
